batting.name: W Jaffer
batting.dismissal: c HH Gibbs b PP Ojha

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c SB Bangar b RP Singh

batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c AS Yadav b SB Styris

batting.name: AC Gilchrist
batting.dismissal: c W Jaffer b Z Khan

batting.name: HH Gibbs
batting.dismissal: c A Kumble b P Kumar

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c W Jaffer b JH Kallis

batting.name: Shahid Afridi
batting.dismissal: c DW Steyn b P Kumar

balls.text: comes round the wicket, Dravid scoops this over extra cover and Yadav at the deep just hangs onto it inches before the rope
shot! the ball is overpitched on middle and leg and he lofts this through the line over long-on

Praveen fails to control the scoop over short fine leg and the ball lobs off his glove and just falls short of the fielder, the running was circumspect and in the end it was an an wasy run-out at the bowlers end with Praveen miles before the crease
slightly short, he gets on top of it and clubs it in the vacant areas at deep midwicket
this time he overpitches on middle and leg and Dravid slogs this one and makes good contact as the ball lands a few rows back at deep midwicket

Dravid mistimes a slog and places it wide of Styris, he misfields as he collides with Praveen and they set off for a run, Dravid then turns down the run as it wasn't fair on the fielding side. It was a good gesture by Dravid.
holds the length back but sticks to the same length outside the legstump as Praveen tucks it away near his hips and beats short fine leg
impressive! RP overpitches on middle and leg and Praveen shuffles and whips it with intent past midwicket, the timing was great and the placement even better
good length outside off, he taps it straight to point
RP gets his man this time as Boucher makes room for a slog but fails to make contact with a straighter delivery, the ball crashes on to the middle and offstumps
to add insult to injury Boucher makes room and scoops a well pitched up delivery over midwicket, one bounce and four

Dropped: Dravid goes for a wild slog and isn't in control of the stroke, the top edge lobs to Styris at extra cover, he appears to have it covered but the ball lobs off his hand and he fails to latch on to it on the second attempt
stays back and clubs it down to deep square leg

this was a medium pacer almost, beats Dravid as he tries to club this over midwicket and Gilchrist whips off the bails again, the third umpire has a look and confirms that Dravid's backfoot was back at the crease
fires in another quicker one outside off, he misses and Gilchrist whips off the bails
fires this one fuller and flatter on the pads, he slogs across the line and the ball rolls along the turf to deep midwicket
makes room and pushes  a full delivery down to long-on
steps down the track and pounds a high full toss down to long-off
stays back at the crease and pushes this one down to long-on
another offcutter, he chops it in front of point but decides against the single, wide call
slides on the pads, he gently works it away down to square leg
bowls the slow offcutter this time, he rocks back and cuts down to deep point
pitches outside off and he steers it down to third man
comes on straight, Dravid tries to whip it across the line but gets a thin inside edge and the ball rolls to the offside
gets forward and works it through midwicket
slides on the pads, he gets on his knee quickly and paddles it very fine and beats short fine leg
stays back and punches to the on side
lovely delivery, pitches outside off, it grips and turns away sharply, beats him on the forward prod
gets forward and pushes this one to long-on
gets forward and works this one to midwicket
gets a thick inside edge onto his pads as he tries to work it to the on side
pitches on middle he works it to the on side

Misbah goes! Afridi bowls the quicker one, pitches on middle and leg and comes in with the angle, Misbah is beaten for pace and ball clips him high on the pad, Doctrove is convinced, replays showed the ball missing the legstump, he might feel slightly aggrieved with that
slides on the pads, he clips it past midwicket
gives him a bit of width outside off, he punches it to point
he opens the facer of the bat and steers it along the turf this time and places it to third man
he executes the upper cut! The ball rears up on a good length, Dravid gets on his toes and carves it over the slips, not a bad shot at all
opens the face of the bat and gently bads it down to third man
Kohli takes a few paces down to loft that over the infield, RP digs it in short, Kohli fails to get the desired elevation and hands an easy catch for Bangar at deep extra cover
hits a good length on middle and off, he gets across and tucks it down to midwicket
flighted on middle and leg, he gets on his knee and gently sweeps this to short fine leg

the art of deception! Kallis takes a few tentative paces forward but misreads the length of the ball, it is short and comes on straight and takes out the middle stump, the joy on Ojha's face says it all
makes room and cuts this firmly through the on side, Styris gathers the ball and hurls it back to Gilchrist and limits that to a single
flighted on  middle and leg, he he clips it with his wrists wide of midwicket
ricks back and cuts this to deep extra cover
going, going, gone!  Kohli picks the flight early, he dances down the track and carts this high into the second tier over long-off
takes a few paces down the track, meets the ball on the full and works it to long-on
hits a good length outside off and gets it to curve in, he gets forward and glides it down to third man
that's a gentle full toss on the pads and he clips it down to deep midwicket
takes a few paces down the track and Vijaykumar bowls this a bit shorter, he clips it straight to midwicket
holds the length back but still slides towards the pads, he nudges it gently off his pads to the on side
he strays too full and wide down the leg side and Kallis gets a feather tough to it and it's enough to beat the keeper

Ojha changes his line of attack by bowling over the wicket, the track works as Jaffer gets on his knee and tries to slog across the line, he gets a thick leading edge and Gibbs takes the skier at extra cover
takes a few paces forward and pushes it down to deep extra cover
gets forward and works this to the on side
stays back and pulls this over midwicket, Bangar does brilliantly to slide and save it

excellent bit of fielding! Kohli stays back and flat bats a short delivery down to long-off, RP gets in position for the catch but realises he will fall over the rope with the momentum, he wisely gets a hand to it and taps it away and saves a sixer
slides on the pads, he clips it to the on side
this one pitches on a length and straightens, it raps him high on the pads and Afridi appeals, the height saved the batsman
gets back at the crease and takes a quick single down to backward point
gets forward and pushes it down to mid-off on the walk
silken! Afridi tosses it up slowly on middle and off and Jaffer gets across his strumps early and delicately paddles it down to fine leg
makes room and plays a delicate cut down to point and calls quickly for the single, the throw is wide and Afridi tramples over the stumps
Jaffer joins the party this time as he walks across the stumps early and paddles it on the up high over short fine leg, Jaffer's settling into this format quite well
pitches just a touch wide outside off and he places it down to third man
the first of the match! Bangar pitches it up on middle and leg, he picks the length early and slogs it over deep midwicket, the ball lands a few rows back
he makes room to improvise but the ball is much fuller for the lofted stroke and he ends up mistiming it to square leg
strays on middle and leg this time and he clips it behind square on the on side
pitches on off and middle and straightens, he punches it wide of point
pushes it down to the vacant midwicket region, Ojha runs across, slides and intercepts it but just fumbles and that allows a second run
charges down the track bu Ojha holds the length back a little and Jaffer checks his stroke and places it towards cover instead
rocks back and uses his bottom hand this time as he pulls over midwicket
gets back and pushes this one to the offside
rocks back at the crease and tucks this one firmly down to Affridi at deep midwicket
pitches outside off, not much turn, he punches it to cover
opens the face of the bat but fails to beat short third man
gets across and tucks this one to midwicket, quiet over so far
slightly short in length, he gets across his stumps and tucks it softly in front of square leg
slides on the pads, he tucks it behind square leg
pushes a full delivery firmly through the line and Yadav has to dive at deep extra cover to intercept it
pitches outside off, he pushes it to the offside
full on middle and leg, he pushes it to long-on
pushes this just in front of mid-on
fuller in length, he steers it behind square but fails to beat short third man
slightly short of a length, he makes room at the crease, gets on top of the bounce and punches it past extra cover, super placement
slides down the leg side, he clips to short fine leg
flights it outside off and cramps him for room, he opens the face and softly steers it to  short third man
pushes a full delivery firmly down the ground, Bangar slides at long-on and intercepts it
slides on the pads, he clips it behind square on the on side
pitches on off and middle, he tucks it wide of square leg
pitches on off and straightens, he defends back to the bowler
tries to work it through the on side but just checks his stroke as he chips it uppishly past midwicket
slides wide down leg and Gilchrist collects it qiuckly and whips off the bails, he's upto the stumps
bowls it full and slow on the pads and he works it to backward square leg
bangs it short outside off, this one kicks up a little but he lets it go
brilliant placement! Fractionally short outside off and directed away from the body, his elbows are high as he punches it off the meat of the bat past backward point and cover
strays a little too wide outside off and the away movement doesn't help RP's cause
tries to run this one down to third man with soft hands but the ball lands well in front of Laxman at first slip
fullish outside off, he drives softly through the line and places it just wide of cover
pitches outside off and straightens, he pushes it softly to the offside
bangs this one short and the ball rears up, Jaffer stands tall and executes an upper cut over the slips
pitches on the pads again, he works this behind square on the on side
pitches this towards the pads, Jaffer uses his wrists to good effect and clips this wide of midwicket, the outfield is too quick for Bangar who slides and fails to cut it off
takes a couple of paces down the track and lofts this elegantly through the line over the bowler, superb timing there
pitches on a good length and seams away a touch, he shapes to punch this one through the offside but gets beaten
shapes to cut but doesn't get too much room, he still manages to place it firmly to backward point
lands this one full and straight and he pushes it firmly back to the bowler
this comes back in and cramps him up for room as he tries to glide this behind square on the offside, he only manages a thick inside edge which pegs back his legstump
slides towards the pads and Chipli stays at the crease and uses his wrists well as he flicks it wide of midwicket
grants him a little bit of width outside off, it was slightly short but Chipli angles it down very neatly and beats backward point
taps it down softly and risks a single to Afridi at short cover who falls forward and flicks the stumps on the dive
this one too shoots up fairly quickly and squares him up with the indipper, he adjusts by opening the face of the bat and dabbing it to third man
rears up on a good length and he nearly chips it on the full back to RP, it falls wide of him and they pick up a single
this one kicks up a little on him, he shapes to defend but gets an inside edge
strays a bit on the pads and he whips it away down to RP Singh at fine leg, he;s fielding a lot squarer
just seaming away a little after pitching on a fullish length and he drives to Afridi at short cover who slides and intercepts it
just a little wide outside off and it holds its line before reaching Gilchrist, not much bounce so far
pitches it fuller and slightly wide outside off and he opens out and dabs it to third man
hits a good length outside off and comes on at a good pace, he tucks it to square leg
Kumble fires on a yorker length and Yadav can only put this away along the turf to deep midwicket
goes down the track and manages a thick inside edge onto his pads, they steal a single and Boucher;s flick misses the stumps
boy oh boy! Of all times Kumble has to bowl a full toss and Bangar bangs this high over deep midwicket!
one of the flattest sixes you'll see! Bangar charges down the track and creams this low over extra cover
full on the stumps again and this time it's a single again, mistimed to deep square leg
full on the stumps and he only manages to slog it doen to deep square leg
superb finish to the over as Zaheer fires in a yorker and Bangar only manages to single to mid-off
Deccan are struggling to put them away as Yadav fails to despatch a full toss and only manages to place it to long-off
delivers a fast yorker from round the wicket and he drags it down to midwicket, another single
bangs it in short and gets it to skid through, he goes for the pull but is beaten for pace as the ball clips his pads
Bangar gets a snorter first up and he's in a tangle, he somehow gets a thick outside edge and the ball goes on the first bounce to third man

and another! Zaheer lands a slower ball outside the legstump, Styris attempts an across the line swipe but the ball raps in plumb in front of middle, umpire Suresh Shastri raises the finger and Zaheer is the highest wicket taker in the tournament

another wickets adds to the drama! Pitches just a fraction outside leg and lands on a full length, Laxman tries to work it to the on side but is too late on the stroke, Praveen appeals as soon as the ball hits the pads and Doctrove raises the finger
keeps him quiet as Laxman pushes a single down to long-off
pitches outside leg and raps him on the pads as he tries to work it to the on side, Praveen appeals for whatever it was worth
lands on a fullish length outside off, and he pushes it down to long-off
continues from round the wicket and it's another low full toss, he softly nudges it down to fine leg

That was a stunner! Praveen delivers a low full toss from round the wicket, Afridi stays at the crease and clubs that high over the on side, Steyn has quite a bit of ground to cover running forward from long-on but times his dive perfectly and pulls it off inches off the turf
makes room and clubs this one down to long-on
Kallis gets his man this time! He overpitched on the pads and invites the loft, he fails to clear long-on this time and Jaffer takes it easily, the crowd applaud another fine innings by Rohit
Laxman makes room and carves a fullish delivery over cover, the fielder in the deep picks it up
flicks his wrists and places a full delivery down to long-on
You can't keep a good man down! He overpitches on middle and leg and he gets across his stumps and paddles that high over square leg, that was improvisation at its best
gets forward and scoops that high over the bowler, long-on would have gobbled that up but the field was in, that's his fifty as well
Steyn ends an excellent over by beating him outside off, he shapes to glide that down to third man but the pace beats him to it
he carves a full delivery down to third man but a brilliant effort by Jaffer saves a certain boundary, that ball was really travelling
makes room to carve that over the on side but the pace beats him, the bounce too is too much for Rohit's comfort
swivels and pulls a short one off his glove, the ball rolls to the on side and that's his fifty

taps it softly towards mid-off and sets off, Steyn runs forward, gathers the ball himself and takes out the middle stump at the non-striker's end, the third umpire has a look and Rohit just makes it back
Steyn returns and immediately gets the ball to talk as he thuds on in short and gets it to rear on Rohit
Laxman searches for the single to bring up his fifty but he's squared up by the extra bounce, he wafts at it outside the offstump
pitches outside off, he places it towards backward point
attempts a delicate late cut but places it within Boucher's reach, he misjudges the bounce and they pick up a bye off the fumble
a half volley outside the offstump and Rohit leans onto the loft and scoops it over extra cover, neat timing
slightly slower in pace and he leans onto the drive a little early, as a result he chips one on the up to long-off and nearly cleans up the non-striker
lands on a half volley on the pads and straightens, he whips it to deep square leg
the slower ball, it lands on the half volley and Laxman elegantly drags that from outside the offstump and places it over midwicket
bowls that quicker and adjusts to a shorter length, he punches it to cover this time
another easy single as he has all the time in the world to angle it down to third man
not that short to pull but he adjusts well and plays it off the meat of the bat down to deep midwicket
full outside off and he easily pushes it through the line past the vacant spaces at extra cover
pitches outside off, he opens the face of the bat and angles it down to third man
fires in the yorker, he digs it out
Praveen dishes out a half volley and that's in the slot for Rohit as he scoops that through the line over long-on, he made that look effortless
bangs in a bouncer, good response by Praveen
almost a run-out! Rohit pushes it to Steyn at mid-off and Laxman is already off the blocks, he slips and struggles to make his ground but luckily for him a fumble by Steyn allows his time to get back
an attempted yorker turns into a low full toss, he flicks it straight to midwicket
pitches on the pads and that's an easy scoring opportunity as he works it down to fine leg
slides on the pads, he works it down to fine leg
Kumble errs by bowling a full toss, Laxman seizes on it and clips this off the meat of the bat wide of midwicket
flighted outside off, he steps down the track and places it high over extra cover, a little more power and that would have carried over the rope
full again, he pushes it with conviction to long-off to bring up the 50 partnership
fullish in length, he pushes through the line to long-off
that was marginally short of a length, Laxman rocks back, makes room and crashes that past extra cover, raw power there
short of a length on middle and he swivels and pulls to fine leg
full outside off and he pushes this one through the line to deep cover
awesome! Kallis gives him a bit of width outside off but Rohit makes more room for himself and plays a delicate glide past the keeper and short third man, talk about improvisation!

Laxman's in a tangle as he tries to fend off a short delivery, the ball lobs off his gloves but the placement is so good that it lands well in front of both Boucher and Kallis who run forward for the catch

takes the aerial route and scoops it over extra cover, Steyn and Misbah converge at the boundary and Misbah appears to pull it back before the rope, the third umpire has a look and he confirms that Misbah's boot was touching the rope when he gathered the ball
tries to work this to the on side but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads, the ball dribbles to the offside
gets forward and clips this to the on side
slides down the legside, he shapes to sweep but misses
gets forward and pushes it to the on side
driven with intent down the pitch and Kumble gets a hand to it, the ball rebounds off him but he's quick to the task, runs back and pulls it back, the home crowd love it
the ball stops on him but he checks the on drive and chips it on the up to long-on
full on middle and leg, he pushes it through the line to long-on
lands on middle and leg, he stays back waits for the turn before clipping it behind square on the on side
another slower ball, the offcutter lands on off and middle and he flicks this one down to long-on
the slower ball, varies his length by pitching it full and Laxman pushes this through the line to long-off
great over so far by Kallis as he bangs one in short and gets it to fizz past Laxman, he ducks and the ball just sails past him
this one shoots through low and squares up Rohit and Boucher who fumbles and they steal a bye
another slower one, the offcutter grips and Rohit pushes it back to Kallis
starts off with a slower one, he decides to stay back and tap it back to the bowler
bowls the yorker this time, he gets his bat down and squeezes it out towards mid-off
pitches outside off, he taps it front of cover
fractionally short and too wide, he stays back at the crease and plays an elegant square cut, the timing was good and the placement good enough to beat deep extra cover
gets a bit of width outside off, he opens the face of the bat and dabs it to third man
hits a good length on the pads, he shuffles and tucks it down to fine leg
fractionally short, he picks the length early, gets on top of the bounce and bludgeons it past square leg
gets forward and drives to long-off to retain the strike
shot! He flights it on middle and leg and Rohit gets forward and carts it high over deep midwicket, sends that many rows back
flighted outside off, he gets forward and defends to the offside
stays back and punches it down to long-on
keeps a little low and he adjusts well and punches it past the bowler and down to long-on
slides on the pads and Laxman works it on its way with his wrists and places it to deep square leg
nips back in after pitching, he covers the line and gently taps it down in front of cover and sets off for a quick single
shapes away after pitching and Rohit helps himself to a single down to third man
goes for a wild pull but plays a little too early, the bounce is lower than expected and that squares him up
drags the line closer to the offstump, he stays back, covers the line and defends
pitches outside off and seams away, Rohit chases it and punches it off the meat of the bat to point

and the bowling change works! Praveen pitches it short of a length outside off, Gibbs stays at the crease to flat bat it but the ball stops on him, he gets a thick top edge and Kumble at mid-off takes the sitter
pushed firmly through the line but some good commitment by Kumble at mid-off limits that to a dot ball
pitches outside off and seams away, he shoulders arms again
deceives him with a slower ball, Gibbs shoulders arms
short outside off and he punches this firmly down to cover
short of a length on middle and leg and Gibbs pulls it past the diving midwicket fielder, that was all power, he catches the length early and plays his favourite stroke
bangs it in short and Gibbs withdraws the stroke, almost like he lost sight of the ball
superb timing, the ball was on a good length and a gentle defensive push beats the bowler and a diving mid-off

just inches off the rope! Gilchrist latches onto a short ball and pulls to deep square leg, Jaffer catches it barely inches off the rope and the momentum takes him one step back, he looks back and his foot is just before the rope and claims the catch, Gilchrist trusts Jaffer and walks
strays off line and he sprays that on the pads, he pulls and there's nobody at fine leg to intercept it
jammed in on a fullish length and he thuds it back to the bowler, the crowd get excited thinking it's a return catch
slower ball, he plays another wristy flick over square leg this time and the timing it so good that it nearly carries to Misbah on the full at fine leg
hits a good length on middle and off, he tucks it down to square leg
pushes a half volley firmly through the line and Kumble slides to his right and cuts it off
vintage Laxman! Swings in on the pads and Laxman gets forward, plays a wristy flick and places it high over midwicket
the slower ball beats Laxman as it pitches on a length and seams away, hardly any foot movement
he swivels and pulls it down to fine leg, Zaheer nearly over-runs the ball but manages to hang onto it before the rope, he shows his relief
first false shot by Gilchrist as he checks the drive and taps it uppishly to mid-off, that was in the air for a while
gets back and taps a good length delivery down to mid-off
overthrows, Gilchrist taps it in front of point and Misbah has a shy at the batsman's end, there's nobody to back the throw and Deccan accepts the bonus
slides just a little wide outside off, he opens the face of the bat and steers it down to third man
bowls the yorker outside off, Laxman gently digs it out, good ball
just short of a drivable length outside off and Laxman gently taps it to mid-off
full outside off and Chipli at short cover does well to slide and intercept it to his right
pitches full and skids through on Laxman, pushes at it tentatively and manages to beat extra cover
pitches short of a length outside off, the ball comes on rather quick as Gilchrist cuts this just above backward point's (Kohli) outstretched hands, the ball rocketed to the boundary
skids through off a good length and cramps him for room as he gets back and taps it towards mid-off
full and wide outside off, in the slot to drive and Gilchrist places it straight to extra cover
strays on the pads, he clips it away easily to midwicket
even faster, 146 kph, pitches outside off and seams away, Laxman plays a nothing shot really
142 kph again, this one comes on straight and thuds onto his pads as he tries to whip it through
fires that wide outside off, 142 kph, this guy's fun to watch
